name: operations.rule_status

list.description: Read native summary transfer-rule run overview records in one fixed response.

parameters.name: trigger-from
parameters.description: Inclusive expected-trigger UTC lower second, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or explicit numeric offset normalized to UTC.

parameters.name: trigger-to
parameters.description: Inclusive expected-trigger UTC upper second, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ or numeric offset; entire final second through .999 is included.

purpose: Inspect expected and actual rule trigger summaries without executing rules or expanding detail.

fields.name: id
fields.meaning: Native positive integer overview-record identity, distinct from ruleId.

fields.name: expectTriggerTime
fields.meaning: Native epoch milliseconds interpreted in UTC; final requested second includes .999.

fields.name: realTriggerTime
fields.meaning: Native actual trigger epoch milliseconds or null; unchanged.

identity_description: Native JSON integer id, never a business-reference substitution or synthetic key.
limitations: Summary queryDetailed="false" only; no expanded true query, ruleId detail or execution endpoint.

Both explicit UTC trigger bounds are required; Z and numeric offsets normalize to native UTC whole seconds. Equal bounds select one entire second; the upper bound includes .999 milliseconds. Native epoch integers and null actual trigger times remain unchanged.

Exactly one qualified pageSize5000 response with native total; this is not a measured maximum. Totals above5000, duplicate IDs or count deficits fail strict publication; narrow the trigger range instead of using unstable paging.

Only the assigned ten-field summary projection is published: id, ruleId, executeStatus, createdOrder, bizNo, orderStatus, expectTriggerTime, realTriggerTime and optional gmtCreate/gmtModified. Amounts, aliases, operators, free text and environment metadata are excluded; ruleId is not row identity.
Bare offline List replays saved trigger scope; failures and complete-empty refresh preserve prior nonempty cache under standard host policy. No Get, with-detail or runtime Duckdog import contract.
